product.name: Interactive Product Demo Software

product.name: Playbooks
product.description: A tool to track and act on accounts and leads engaging with interactive demos by revealing buyer interactions throughout their journey.

product.name: Demo Personalization Features
product.description: Capabilities to personalize demos using dynamic variables, route visitors to custom demos, and translate demos into multiple languages.

product.name: Offline Demos
product.description: Downloadable interactive demos for use at conferences and tradeshows without requiring internet connectivity.

product.name: Integrations and Alerts
product.description: Integration with CRM and marketing platforms to sync demo engagement data and provide real-time alerts via Slack and email.
